pretreatments.description: Grinding to pass through a 12 mm sieve using a shredder-chipper (Mighty Mac, Mackissic Inc., Parker Ford, PA, USA).

Ensilage: Supplemented with water to reach a total solids (TS) content of around 40%, packed into 1-gallon-size zipper bags (Ziploc Vacuum Freezer System, SC Johnson Inc., Racine, WI, USA) with 1 kg of wet giant reed in each bag, vacuumed to minimize oxygen, and placed at room temperature (25 ± 3 °C).

Fungal pretreatment: C. subvermispora (ATCC 96608) inoculum prepared by activating the fungus on 2% malt extract agar plates at 28 °C for 7 days, followed by liquid inoculum preparation and homogenization with sterilized DI water.
Mixing thoroughly after 60 days of ensilage.
Storage at −20 °C for AD and enzymatic hydrolysis tests.
Enzymatic hydrolysis using cellulase (Cellic CTec 2, Novozymes, Denmark) at 50 °C with shaking at 180 rpm for 72 h, followed by filtration.
Anaerobic digestion (AD) in a mesophilic liquid anaerobic digester (KB BioEnergy, Akron, OH, USA) with sewage sludge inoculum at 37 ± 1 °C for 30 days.
